_about: Ryan's picks, each source render kept beside this file at full size for later fixes. The first pass is of 9 October; on 13 October he picked the wildlife again from the battle-pose takes (the original sets retired) and changed four heroes; later that day every hero was re-picked from the diversity pass (one take drawn as chibi and boss) except the Summoner, whose takes were redrawn without fire. role: sprite (cut into art/foes at its frame), chibi (a hero's sprite for its domain's final, cut at 36x48), promoted (the boss register for the hero's promoted form, waiting on its entry). prompt is what rendered it; candidate is the seed, which in a takes set is also the take's number in design.variants. cut is the cutter's options that pick needed (--tol 90 for a grey ground shadow, --glow for a coloured glow, --height 46 on every chibi so the party stands at one scale; pockets of pure white key by default since 14 October). note is Ryan's phone note on the pick, verbatim: what to fix. marked holds candidates he set aside for another use, with his note. fix.from is the render a fix edited; a source under out/<foe>_hand is a PIL edit by a session, its prompt.txt saying what was done.
